jobs.title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte
jobs.description: Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau (Reinickendorf) suchen wir dich als Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer für internationale Internatsaufenthalte (m/w/d). Auch Quereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen! Wir sind Akademis Internatsberatung, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsagentur. Wir helfen Familien, ein passendes Internat im Ausland zu finden, und begleiten sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Rückkehr ihres Kindes. Dabei teilen wir ihre Vorfreude, nehmen ihre Sorgen ernst und kümmern uns um die vielen kleinen und großen Fragen unterwegs. Eine Aufgabe, die dir am Herzen liegt Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, dem gute Arbeit persönlich wichtig ist: Du möchtest Eltern und Jugendliche aufmerksam begleiten, hältst Zusagen ein und bleibst an offenen Anliegen dran. Auch bei den Details arbeitest du gewissenhaft – denn auf deine Auskünfte, Unterlagen und Absprachen sollen sich andere verlassen können. Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der die persönliche Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team schätzt und selbst zu einer guten Atmosphäre beiträgt: mit Freundlichkeit, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einem ehrlichen, respektvollen Umgang. Dafür stehen dir eine gründliche Einarbeitung und ein hilfsbereites Team zur Seite. Aufgaben Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen. jobs.title: Finance Intern
jobs.description: Finance & Investor Relations Intern - Berlin Cherry Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2012 and based in Berlin, London and Stockholm. We are a team of former entrepreneurs and operators with experience building fast-scaling companies such as Zalando, Spotify and Uber. We have invested in over 140 companies across Europe, including Flix, Auto1, Amboss, Manual, Numa, Moss, Swap, Tacto and The Exploration Company. We are looking for an additional team member to join as a Finance & Investor Relations Intern starting January 2027 for a period of 3-6 months . For this role: You would need to either have an EU passport or an existing permit to work in Germany as we are unfortunately not able to sponsor visas . jobs.description: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und unsere Agentur aktiv mitgestalten? Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in der IT und Prozessautomatisierung, ergänzt durch vielseitige Entwicklungsaufgaben. Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst stets den Überblick. Digitale Tools sind für Dich selbstverständlich, neue Technologien – insbesondere KI – gehst Du offen und neugierig an. Du hast Freude an Programmierung, Vibe-Coding und modernen IT-Lösungen. Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich als Verstärkung für unser Team. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudierenden IT (m/w/d) 16 Stunden/Woche (Erhöhung auf 20 Stunden nach der Probezeit möglich). Mindestens ein Tag Präsenz vor Ort ist gewünscht, der Rest kann im Homeoffice erfolgen. Deine Aufgaben Automatisierung von internen Prozessen, Marketing, Vertrieb, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung Bau von kleineren Anwendungen für uns und für Kunden Mitarbeit bei unseren internen digitalisierungs Projekte wie Marketing Dashboard, Content Maschin, Software Factory Perspektivisch Mitarbeit bei Kundenprojekten im Bereich IT Unsere Anforderungen Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit IT-Schwerpunkt. Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit Tools wie n8n, Claude oder GitHub gesammelt. Du verfügst über grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse und interessierst Dich für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung (Vibe-Coding). Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit der Automatisierung von Prozessen und der Entwicklung kleiner Anwendungen. Du interessierst Dich für digitales Marketing, Webentwicklung und Social Media. Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst klar und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und Dich selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten. Benefits bei Online Experience GmbH Dein Einstieg: Du erhältst fachliche Unterstützung durch einen erfahrenen IT-Experten. jobs.description: Wir sind ekipa. Als Corporate Venturing Partner helfen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen die besten Innovationen mit den besten Partnern und einer erprobten & etablierten Methodik zu realisieren. Dafür befähigen und begleiten wir entlang des ganzen Innovationsprozesses. Mit diesem Ansatz adressieren wir die großen Herausforderungen unserer Gegenwart und Zukunft. Vor diesem Hintergrund arbeiten wir auch mit politischen Institutionen zusammen. Mit unseren inspirierenden Innovationsprojekten in den Bereichen Nachhaltigkeit, Digitalisierung, Health Tech und weiteren Themenfeldern haben wir bereits zahlreiche Kunden befähigt, neue Lösungen , Geschäftsmodelle und Innovationen zu entwickeln. Und für die Zukunft planen wir noch Größeres. Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen, suchen wir engagierte, innovationshungrige Mitstreiter:innen, die gemeinsam mit Partnern wie Samsung, Rolex, Bayer oder politischen Partnern an zukunftsweisenden Herausforderungen arbeiten möchten. Aufgaben Da wir ein Startup sind, bekommst du im Rahmen deines Praktikums bei uns Einblicke in unterschiedliche Tätigkeitsfelder und kannst ab Tag 1 Verantwortung übernehmen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: Du übernimmst verschiedene projektrelevante Aktivitäten wie z.B. die Identifikation passender Innovator:innen für ein Innovationsprojekt, die Vorbereitung projektrelevanter Dokumente und nicht zuletzt bist du in unser Eventmanagement eingebunden. jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
jobs.description: About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Role summary How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality? We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. jobs.title: Business Development Manager:in (all genders)
jobs.description: CHEEX is a progressive platform for sexual entertainment and education, where people of all sexual orientations and identities can safely and freely enjoy inspiring content. This is a 12-month mandate: you’ll work directly with our CMO to build new growth engines for CHEEX. Your mission: spot untapped marketing and sales opportunities, turn them into MVPs at speed, and validate what actually works in the market yourself. We’re looking for someone with drive, curiousity, ambitious and wired to think outside the box, who turns rough ideas into experiments and experiments into results. You’ll play an active role in shaping our future growth here. Tasks You’ll identify, test, and validate new marketing and sales opportunities to grow our customer base. You’ll take full operational ownership of strategic initiatives, from shaping and prioritizing them together with our CMO through to evaluating results. You’ll build new acquisition channels and commercial initiatives from scratch and bring them to market. You’ll use modern software and AI tools to spin up prototypes (MVPs) fast and cost-effectively, then test them directly in the market. You confidently use modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini) to massively speed up research, analysis, automation, and MVP development. You’ll act as an independent self-starter, taking ideas from 0 to 1 with minimal guidance, validating results, and deciding what's next. jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description: About us Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results. Project description (TUM Project) This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact. The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice. Objectives of the project study to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand), to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective, to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results, to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect. Main task and methodology Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling. Student requirements Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Your mission As a Test Engineer – Automated Systems, you will work hand in hand with our Electronics Hardware and Embedded Software teams to prove that our devices perform, in the lab and on the job site. You will build the test benches, HiL setups, and automated frameworks that uncover issues early and make sure every product we ship is safe, reliable, and ready for real-world use. Your impact Develop and improve our in-house automated test framework and test infrastructure. Design, implement, and maintain automated tests for embedded products and system functions. Work with test software written in Python, C#, and C++, and contribute to its architecture and maintainability. Extend and improve hardware-coupled test setups, including HiL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) systems, measurement equipment, control interfaces, and test benches. Analyze test results and failures across software, firmware, electronics, and test hardware. Support traceability from requirements to test cases, verification results, and validation evidence. Collaborate closely with firmware, electronics, product, and quality teams to improve test methods, coverage, and reliability. Help shape test processes that scale from development testing to release validation and production-oriented testing. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. In this role, you will manage issues from their first symptom to their eventual resolution, communicating with our customers and internal stakeholders throughout the process. jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.description: GTM Associate London, 4x days per week in-office Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth. About Vega Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side. Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right. Who we are We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do. How we do it Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you: We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress.

You will work directly with customer operations to turn real-world processes into reliable software that improves how these workflows are carried out. What You'll Do Work alongside customers to understand how certification, inspection, and compliance processes operate in practice. Lead customer calls, write product specifications, and build full-stack systems from user interface through backend, data model, and AI components. Use judgment to distinguish customer requests that apply broadly from those that are specific to one workflow. Analyze customer documents and real-world outputs to develop AI-enabled workflows for scheduling, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence. What We're Looking For Three to six years of software or product engineering experience, with a record of building and shipping production systems. Full-stack development skills, including Python backend services, TypeScript, React or a similar modern frontend framework, and data modeling. Experience integrating AI or machine learning systems into production products, including LLMs or document intelligence. Experience building products or systems from the ground up, ideally in an early-stage or founding engineering environment. Comfort working directly with customers and translating operational needs into durable software. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. jobs.description: Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line. With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years. This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles. What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment. The opportunity You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to. You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
tags: ltds - laboratoire de tribologie et dynamique des systèmes
jobs.description: Contexte Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. jobs.description: You want to help build Europe's resilience. You want to protect people and critical infrastructure - ultimately saving the lives of thousands. You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems. At CDDS, you'll build the software platform that connects our next-generation interceptor drones with sensors and operators, the nervous system of a counter-drone defense network protecting critical infrastructure and, ultimately, saving lives. jobs.description: SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app. We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. In this role, you will own Accounts Payable and contribute across the full scope of the accounting function: month-end close, reconciliations, intercompany, VAT and tax, and audit preparation. The ideal candidate can step into any part of the accounting cycle, from processing supplier invoices to preparing audit files. You will: Own the Accounts Payable process: supplier invoice review and coding (ApprovalMax/Xero), payment preparation, supplier statement reconciliations and vendor master data Prepare and manage general ledger entries, accruals and prepayments Monthly, quarterly and annual closes for all group entities, in collaboration with external accounting firms Balance sheet and bank reconciliations, and account analysis to ensure balances are correct and supported Monthly intercompany reconciliations, recharges and settlements

jobs.description: Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub. Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests. jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleid

De bouwplaats wordt steeds digitaler. Data, IoT, AI, SaaS-oplossingen, sensoren en realtime monitoring bieden mogelijkheden om niet alleen afzonderlijke producten digitaal te ondersteunen, maar de bouwplaats als geheel slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter te maken. Wat ga je doen? Hoe kan RECO een schaalbaar digitaal platform/concept ontwikkelen waarmee bouwplaatsen integraal digitaal kunnen worden gemonitord, aangestuurd en geoptimaliseerd, waarbij SaaS, AI, IoT en bestaande RECO-diensten samenkomen? Daarbij staat niet één afzonderlijk product centraal, maar de vraag: Hoe ziet de bouwplaats van de toekomst eruit en welke digitale rol kan RECO daarin vervullen? Het doel is om een conceptueel uitgewerkt en onderbouwd digitaliseringsconcept op te leveren dat RECO kan gebruiken als basis voor verdere ontwikkeling en eventuele realisatie. De opdracht moet nadrukkelijk voorkomen dat er alleen een theoretisch adviesrapport ontstaat. Je wordt uitgedaagd om hands-on met technologie te werken en waar mogelijk een werkend prototype of proof-of-concept te ontwikkelen. Jij sleutelt aan personen- en goederenliften, loopt ze volledig na en zorgt dat storingen snel opgelost worden. Of het nou mechanisch of elektrisch is: jij zoekt het probleem op en vindt de passende oplossing. Ook bij grotere of ingewikkelde storingen draai jij je hand niet om voor een goede oplossing. At Thermeleon, we're looking for a Marketing & Branding Intern to help shape our brand identity, create engaging content, and increase our visibility in the greenhouse horticulture sector. Our product, the Thermeleon Heat Battery, is an innovative day-night buffer for greenhouses. It improves energy efficiency by strategically reusing surplus heat, reducing natural gas consumption and supporting the transition towards climate-neutral horticulture. As a Marketing & Branding Intern, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a wide range of marketing activities, from developing our new brand identity to creating visual content, managing our LinkedIn presence, and communicating our latest developments. You'll work closely with the team to translate complex technology into clear, engaging stories. Marketing Materials: Design and develop marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers, business cards, and other visual assets. Content Creation: Create engaging content for LinkedIn, newsletters, our website, and other communication channels to share company updates, projects, and innovations. Photography & Videography: Organize and produce visual content, including professional photography, drone footage, team photos, and project shoots at greenhouse locations. Social Media Management: Develop and maintain a content calendar, manage our LinkedIn presence, and identify opportunities to increase our reach and engagement. jobs.title: Merchant Growth Specialist
jobs.description: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more visibility in AI search, more direct orders without commission, and a stronger performance on the delivery platforms restaurants already use. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers. As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. Een fijne collega die ziet wat er moet gebeuren, dit zelfstandig oppakt en zorgt dat zaken niet blijven liggen. Je bent praktisch ingesteld, houdt overzicht en vindt het prettig om zaken van het begin tot het einde op te pakken. Taken In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse uitvoering van verschillende HR-werkzaamheden. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en neemt actief zaken op je. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Opstellen en verwerken van arbeidsovereenkomsten, contractwijzigingen en andere personeelsdocumenten. Verzorgen van de administratieve afhandeling rondom indiensttreding, wijzigingen en uitdiensttreding. Verzorgen van de verlofadministratie. Bijhouden, controleren en compleet houden van personeelsdossiers. Actief oppakken van binnenkomende vragen en verzoeken uit de HR-mailbox. Krijg jij energie van het coördineren van projecten en zorg jij ervoor dat alles op het juiste moment op de juiste plek is? Dan is deze functie bij OX Power in Barneveld iets voor jou! Taken Als Werkvoorbereider ben jij dé spil tussen verkoop, werkplaats, leveranciers en klanten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten van begin tot eind strak gepland zijn en volgens planning verlopen. Je houdt continu overzicht over de voortgang, signaleert knelpunten voordat ze ontstaan en stuurt bij waar nodig. Een groot deel van jouw functie draait om plannen en coördineren. Je zorgt ervoor dat materialen tijdig aanwezig zijn, de productie efficiënt verloopt en monteurs en collega’s weten wat er wanneer moet gebeuren. Dankzij jouw organisatorische vaardigheden lopen projecten soepel en kunnen deadlines worden gehaald. Tijdens je inwerkperiode maak je ook kennis met onze werkplaats en techniek, zodat je onze producten en processen goed leert begrijpen. jobs.title: Triage audicien - Beek, Limburg
jobs.description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belan

jobs.description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Zuid Nederland Omschrijving van het team Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers. Taken Wat ga je doen? Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. jobs.title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
jobs.description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. jobs.title: Project Manager - Managed Services
jobs.description: Over CBRE Global Workplace Solutions CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen. Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
jobs.description: The role HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision. As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and  felt . You re not building the ranking algorithm, you re building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me . This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make. What you’ll do Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You ll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform. The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn t just UX work, it s trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack. Cross-Org Data Supplier : You re the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces. AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow.

jobs.description: About the role At HelloFresh, data is at the heart of everything we do — from the moment a customer places an order to the way we forecast demand, optimize our supply chain, and personalize experiences for millions of people. Making that data fast, reliable, and available is what our Data Platform makes possible. We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join our Operational Data Platform team — the squad that ensures operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with the quality guarantees that everything downstream depends on — so the analytics layer receives quality data, ready to be turned into governed assets. You will build the streaming, messaging, and self-service provisioning systems that hundreds of backend and data engineers rely on every day. This is a hands-on engineering role at the core of our platform. You ll own critical infrastructure, drive efficiency, and help define the "golden path" that makes it effortless for engineers across the company to store and stream their data — with governance and cost control built in from the start. What you ll do Build and run our streaming and messaging platform. Own the systems that move data in real time and at scale — Kafka, Kafka Connect, Flink, and SQS — and keep them fast, resilient, and easy to build on. Drive efficiency. Identify and act on opportunities to reduce the cost and complexity of the platform, and make efficiency a default rather than an afterthought. Own the reliability of critical data paths. Keep the systems at the heart of the platform highly available, and continuously improve their resilience, observability, and operational maturity. Enable self-service for operational data stores. Build and maintain the Terraform modules and tooling that let engineering teams use the right database for their use case within minutes, with governance and cost guardrails out of the box. jobs.title: Kundenbetreuer:in Beschwerdemanagement (Remote, Telefon)
jobs.description: Über Simplyright Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Du kannst zu deutschen Geschäftszeiten (Mo–Fr) arbeiten. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Das bieten wir 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. Eine gründliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe. jobs.title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) Power BI mit Entscheidungsbefugnis
jobs.description: Über uns Die Weiler Consult GmbH ist eine Power-BI-Boutique für den deutschen Mittelstand und das Konzernumfeld. Rund 10 Power-BI-Expertinnen und -Experten bauen Reporting, das Geschäftsführer und CFOs wirklich nutzen. Unser Prinzip: Wir sind der Sherpa. Wir arbeiten remote-first, deutschlandweit, und treffen uns dreimal im Jahr zur Workation. Worum es geht Du bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, vom Kickoff bis zur Verlängerung. Du machst sichtbar, was unsere Power-BI-Arbeit in den Zahlen des Kunden verändert, und steuerst die Umsetzung mit Entwicklern und Freelancern. In deiner Verantwortung liegen rund 10 bis 12 Kunden. Deine Aufgaben Du führst die Kundenbeziehungen, kennst Ziele und Kennzahlen deiner Kunden und hältst ihr Feedback in ClickUp fest. Du benennst die Veränderung in den Zahlen des Kunden, nicht die gelieferten Dashboards. Mit jedem Kunden führst du pro Quartal ein Strategie- und Roadmap-Gespräch: Zufriedenheit, Erfolge, Zielbild für zwei Jahre, Roadmap. Verlängerungen gehst du aktiv und rechtzeitig vor Vertragsende an. Aus der Roadmap entwickelst du Folgeprojekte. In der Umsetzung schneidest und priorisierst du Aufgaben in ClickUp, hältst Termine und koordinierst Entwickler und Freelancer. Du führst die Power-BI-Entwickler fachlich. Bei Unzufriedenheit, Budgetrisiko oder drohender Abwanderung eskalierst du früh. Das bringst du mit Du führst Kundengespräche selbstständig. Du verstehst betriebswirtschaftliche Zahlen und sprichst mit einem CFO auf Augenhöhe. Du kannst Power-BI-Berichte lesen und erklären. Du hältst Termine zuverlässig. Idealerweise hast du Grundlagen in DAX und Datenmodellierung oder Beratungserfahrung. Eher nichts für dich, wenn du Vertriebsgespräche meidest, lieber selbst entwickelst, über Dashboards statt Ergebnisse sprechen willst, Probleme aussitzt. Woran du gemessen wirst Verlängerungsquote (das Wichtigste), Folgeumsatz, Zufriedenheit und NPS, Quartalsgespräche, Termintreue, Budgettreue. Was wir bieten Zielgehalt 100.00

jobs.description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role bunch is around 155 people across Berlin, London, and Amsterdam, and Luxembourg, on the way to roughly 200 in 2027. Design, build, and roll out automated, AI-supported workflows and integrations across our tools — including Personio (HRIS) and Notion — to eliminate manual work and connect our systems. Coordinate monthly payroll across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands and in the near future, Luxembourg, with our external providers. You own data accuracy, deadlines and the provider relationships — the providers own the processing. Maintain the compliance calendar and the documentation behind it, working with external counsel where local employment law is involved. The team The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and customer lifetime value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Missions As Alan’s Corporate Paralegal, you will own the corporate governance of a fast-growing international group (six jurisdictions and a dozen entities today, more in the coming months) and rebuild how that work gets done with AI.
